title: Recent Advances in Cold-Sprayed Aluminum Alloy 7075 Metal Matrix Composite Coatings: Surface Engineering, Feedstock Design, Post-Processing Strategies, and Emerging Applications
authors: Achyuth Kulkarni, Troy Y. Ansell
abstract: Cold spray technology has emerged as a transformative solid-state processing route for fabricating high-performance metal matrix composite (MMC) coatings, particularly for lightweight, high-strength aluminum alloy 7075 (AA7075). This review provides a comprehensive overview of recent advances in cold-sprayed AA7075-based MMC coatings, focusing on critical aspects such as surface engineering, powder feedstock design, post-deposition treatments, and reinforcement strategies. The integration of hard ceramic and nanostructured reinforcements, including B4C, SiC, boron nitride nanoplatelets or tubes (BNNPs/BNNTs), and graphene nanoplatelets (GNPs), has improved the mechanical strength, wear resistance, and corrosion behavior of these coatings. Special emphasis is placed on functionally graded architectures, hybrid reinforcement systems, and densification methods such as heat treatment and hot isostatic pressing. The review also highlights emerging applications in aerospace, defense, and space technologies, including radiation shielding, structural repair, and metallization of polymer substrates. Remaining challenges, such as reinforcement dispersion, interface integrity, and process optimization, are discussed, along with future research directions involving machine learning, real-time diagnostics, and environmental validation. Overall, this review provides an integrated understanding of the processing, microstructure, properties, and applications of cold-sprayed AA7075-based MMC coatings and identifies key research gaps and future directions.
venue: Journal of Manufacturing and Materials Processing

zh-Hans.title: 冷喷铝合金7075金属基复合材料涂层的最新进展：表面工程、供料设计、后处理策略与新兴应用
zh-Hans.abstract: 冷喷涂技术已成为一种变革性的固态加工路线，用于制备高性能金属基复合材料（MMC）涂层，尤其适用于轻质、高强度的铝合金7075（AA7075）。本综述全面概述了冷喷AA7075基MMC涂层的最新进展，重点关注表面工程、粉末供料设计、沉积后处理以及增强策略等关键方面。硬质陶瓷和纳米结构增强体的集成，包括B4C、SiC、氮化硼纳米片或纳米管（BNNPs/BNNTs）以及石墨烯纳米片（GNPs），提高了这些涂层的力学强度、耐磨性和腐蚀行为。本文特别强调功能梯度结构、混杂增强体系以及热处理和热等静压等致密化方法。综述还重点介绍了其在航空航天、国防和空间技术中的新兴应用，包括辐射屏蔽、结构修复以及聚合物基底的金属化。同时讨论了仍然存在的挑战，如增强体分散性、界面完整性和工艺优化，并给出了涉及机器学习、实时诊断和环境验证的未来研究方向。总体而言，本综述对冷喷AA7075基MMC涂层的加工、微观结构、性能和应用提供了系统认识，并指出了关键研究空白和未来方向。

title: Optimization of Friction Stir Welding Parameters for Improving the Mechanical Properties of Aluminum Alloy Joints
authors: Pompy Pratisna, Ferdy Hendarto Susilo, Sutikno Wahyu Hidayat, Dedy Aryanto
abstract: Friction stir welding (FSW) performance depends on the interaction among processing parameters rather than individual operating conditions. This study examined the effects of rotational speed (800, 1000, and 1200 rpm), travel speed (40, 60, and 80 mm/min), and axial force (4, 6, and 8 kN) on the mechanical properties of 6-mm AA6061-T6 butt joints. A 3 × 3 × 3 full factorial design with three reported replicates per condition yielded 81 mechanical-test observations, covering ultimate tensile strength (UTS), yield strength, elongation, and hardness. Factorial analysis of variance (ANOVA) and coded quadratic regression were performed using IBM SPSS Statistics 31. All three parameters showed significant main effects across the four mechanical responses (p < .001), while the Rotation × Travel interaction was significant for each response. Rotational speed exhibited the largest partial effect size for UTS (partial η² = .807). The quadratic regression models explained 72.1%–84.6% of the response variance and identified 1200 rpm, 80 mm/min, and 8 kN as the highest-predicted UTS setting among the 27 evaluated combinations, with a predicted UTS of 280.39 MPa and a calculated joint efficiency of 90.45%. These findings demonstrate the importance of considering parameter interactions when selecting FSW operating conditions, while limiting the model-based recommendation to the investigated material, tool configuration, and experimental range.
venue: Journal of Renewable Energy and Smart Device

zh-Hans.title: 提升铝合金接头力学性能的摩擦搅拌焊参数优化
zh-Hans.abstract: 摩擦搅拌焊（FSW）的性能取决于加工参数之间的相互作用，而非单独的操作条件。本研究考察了转速（800、1000 和 1200 rpm）、行进速度（40、60 和 80 mm/min）以及轴向力（4、6 和 8 kN）对 6-mm AA6061-T6 对接接头力学性能的影响。采用 3 × 3 × 3 全因子设计，并对每种条件设置 3 个报告重复，获得了 81 组力学测试观测值，涵盖极限抗拉强度（UTS）、屈服强度、伸长率和硬度。使用 IBM SPSS Statistics 31 进行因子方差分析（ANOVA）和编码二次回归。三项参数在四个力学响应上均表现出显著主效应（p < .001），而 Rotation × Travel 交互作用对每个响应均显著。转速对 UTS 的部分效应量最大（partial η² = .807）。二次回归模型解释了 72.1%–84.6% 的响应方差，并在 27 组评估组合中识别出 1200 rpm、80 mm/min 和 8 kN 为预测 UTS 最高的设置，其预测 UTS 为 280.39 MPa，计算得到的接头效率为 90.45%。这些结果表明，在选择 FSW 操作条件时应考虑参数交互作用，同时将基于模型的推荐限定于所研究的材料、工具配置和实验范围内。

title: Computational and machine learning modelling approaches for weld quality predictions in friction stir welding of high-density polyethylene
authors: A. Alhourani, I. Barsoum, J. Sheikh-Ahmad, S. Deveci
abstract: Friction stir welding (FSW) has gained recognition as an effective technique for joining thermoplastic materials. This study presents a comprehensive investigation to predict FSW characteristics such as weld temperatures, vertical axial forces, material flow and defect formation in FSW of high-density polyethylene (HDPE) using both computational and machine learning approaches, validated by experimental results. A three-dimensional Coupled Eulerian-Lagrangian (CEL) numerical model is developed to simulate the HDPE welding process under varying process parameters of rotational and welding speeds, and bottom preheating conditions. The CEL numerical model is validated against experimental data, showing markedly good agreement in predicting void formation, thermal and mechanical responses. Results indicate that preheating the bottom surface proved effective in reducing thermal gradients and stabilizing vertical force fluctuations. Quantitatively, bottom-surface preheating at 60 °C reduced peak plunge force from 1600 N close to 1100 N and raised peak temperatures from 70 °C (without preheat) to about 100 °C, hence smoothing through-thickness gradients and stabilizing the axial force distribution. In parallel, two multilayer perceptron artificial neural networks (ANNs) are trained on experimental data to predict temporal temperature and axial force responses with R2 between 0.91 and 0.99, demonstrating high accuracy and strong generalization across the tested FSW parameter space. The computational CEL simulations accurately predicted weld zone morphology, including stir zone, thermo-mechanically affected zone and heat-affected zone, however the combined CEL–ANN framework enables rapid generation of process maps that highlights defective and defect-free welding windows, with optimal conditions obtained at 1500 rpm and 30 mm/min with 60 °C preheating, and poor weldability observed at 1000 rpm without preheating due to wormhole formation. These findings provide process-driven design guidelines for developing robust HDPE joints and demonstrate how integrating computational modeling with machine learning enables efficient optimization, offering valuable insights into the key characteristics of the FSW process in thermoplastics and supporting its broader adoption in industrial applications.

infographic.key_insight: A coupled CEL simulation and ANN surrogate model can accurately predict friction stir welding quality in HDPE and identify process windows that minimize defects.
infographic.engineering_relevance: This work provides practical guidance for selecting rotation speed, traverse speed, and preheating to stabilize force/temperature responses and improve weld integrity in thermoplastics.

infographic.evidence_signal: The ANN models achieved R2 values between 0.91 and 0.99, and the CEL predictions matched experiments for void formation, thermal response, and force trends.

infographic.paper_title: Computational and machine learning modelling approaches for weld quality predictions in friction stir welding of high-density polyethylene

zh-Hans.title: 用于高密度聚乙烯搅拌摩擦焊焊接质量预测的计算与机器学习建模方法
zh-Hans.abstract: 搅拌摩擦焊（FSW）已被公认为一种连接热塑性材料的有效技术。本研究采用计算方法和机器学习方法，并通过实验结果验证，对高密度聚乙烯（HDPE）搅拌摩擦焊中的焊缝温度、竖直轴向力、材料流动及缺陷形成等FSW特征进行了全面研究。建立了三维耦合欧拉-拉格朗日（CEL）数值模型，用于模拟在不同工艺参数（转速、焊接速度和底部预热条件）下的HDPE焊接过程。CEL数值模型通过实验数据进行了验证，在空洞形成以及热和力学响应预测方面表现出显著良好的一致性。结果表明，对底表面进行预热可有效降低热梯度并稳定竖直力波动。定量而言，底表面在60 °C预热时，峰值压入力由接近1600 N降至约1100 N，峰值温度由70 °C（无预热）升至约100 °C，从而平滑了厚度方向梯度并稳定了轴向力分布。与此同时，基于实验数据训练了两个多层感知器人工神经网络（ANN），用于预测时间序列温度和轴向力响应，其R2介于0.91和0.99之间，表明在所测试的FSW参数空间内具有很高的准确性和较强的泛化能力。计算CEL模拟能够准确预测焊缝区形貌，包括搅拌区、热机械影响区和热影响区；而组合CEL–ANN框架可快速生成工艺图，标示有缺陷与无缺陷的焊接窗口，其中在1500 rpm和30 mm/min、并采用60 °C预热时获得最佳条件，而在无预热且1000 rpm时由于蠕虫孔形成而观察到较差的可焊性。这些结果为开发稳健的HDPE接头提供了基于工艺的设计准则，并展示了将计算建模与机器学习相结合如何实现高效优化，为理解热塑性材料中FSW过程的关键特征提供了有价值的见解，并支持其在工业应用中的更广泛采用。

infographic.engineering_relevance: 本研究为选择转速、行进速度和预热条件以稳定力/温度响应并提高热塑性材料焊缝完整性提供了实用指导。

title: Automated Complex for the Reclamation and Anti-Corrosion Protection of Steel Marine Propellers via Supersonic Cold Gas-Dynamic Spraying Utilizing AI-Driven Control
authors: Alexandr Kuzmin
abstract: This paper presents the technological concept and architecture of a robotic manufacturing system (RMS) designed for the precision reclamation and long-term anti-corrosion protection of steel marine propellers utilized in sea-going and river vessels. The proposed method integrates cold gas-dynamic spraying (CGDS) technology with a 6-axis industrial manipulator equipped with an artificial intelligence (AI)-based computer vision system and an automatic tool changer (ATC). This technology mitigates the issues of cavitational and electrochemical degradation of propeller blades by introducing an adaptive manufacturing cycle. This cycle encompasses contactless 3D defect mapping, abrasive preparation, supersonic spraying of functional coatings, and force-controlled (Force-Torque) adaptive finish grinding. This comprehensive approach eliminates thermal distortion of the treated component, minimizes hydrodynamic drag, and extends the operational lifespan of the protective coating by a factor of 4–5 compared to conventional techniques. Furthermore, the economic viability of implementing this technology is evaluated, with a specific focus on the on-site repair of ultra-large vessels (supertankers) without the need for propeller disassembly.Keywords: Cold gas-dynamic spraying, robot manipulator, artificial intelligence, computer vision, marine propeller, cavitation erosion, adaptive grinding, supertankers.
venue: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)

zh-Hans.title: 利用 AI 驱动控制、采用超音速冷气动力喷涂的钢制船用螺旋桨再生与防腐保护自动化综合系统
zh-Hans.abstract: 本文提出了一种机器人制造系统（RMS）的技术概念与架构，旨在对海船和内河船舶所使用的钢制船用螺旋桨进行高精度再生修复和长期防腐保护。所提出的方法将冷气动力喷涂（CGDS）技术与配备基于人工智能（AI）的计算机视觉系统和自动换刀装置（ATC）的 6 轴工业机械臂相结合。该技术通过引入自适应制造循环，缓解了螺旋桨叶片的空蚀和电化学劣化问题。该循环包括无接触式 3D 缺陷映射、磨料预处理、功能涂层的超音速喷涂以及力控制（Force-Torque）自适应精磨。这种综合方法避免了被处理部件的热变形，降低了流体动力阻力，并使保护涂层的使用寿命相较于传统技术延长 4–5 倍。此外，本文还评估了实施该技术的经济可行性，重点关注无需拆卸螺旋桨即可对超大型船舶（超级油轮）进行现场修复。关键词：冷气动力喷涂，机器人机械臂，人工智能，计算机视觉，船用螺旋桨，空蚀磨损，自适应磨削，超级油轮。

title: Effect of spray distance in D-gun sprayed Cr3C2–NiCr coatings on DSS 2205 in acidic environments
authors: Roshan Kuruvila, Mebin T Kuruvila, Manu Harilal, S. Thirumalai Kumaran
abstract: Cermet coating, which is a blend of ceramic hardness and metallic toughness, is mostly applied to enhance the wear and corrosion resistance of metals. Detonation gun ( D -gun) spraying is one of the most promising thermal spray technologies that would produce a high-quality ceramic coating. Cr 3 C 2 -NiCr coating is acceptable because of its superior mechanical characteristics and corrosion characteristic. The effectiveness of D -gun sprayed Cr₃C₂–NiCr coatings was evaluated under aggressive acidic conditions using 1 M H₂SO₄, which serves as a standardized laboratory electrolyte for assessing corrosion resistance relevant to industrial acidic environments, including the key process variables such as spraying distance, which is critically important in the determination of other coating properties such as porosity, adhesion, roughness, and hardness. Duplex stainless steel (DSS) 2205 has been sprayed with Cr 3 C 2 -NiCr at three spraying distances; 170 mm, 180 mm and 190 mm in an attempt to conduct the research on the behavior of Cr 3 C 2 -NiCr in acid conditions. Electrochemical activity of the coating was evaluated in 1 M H 2 SO 4 solutions at room temperature; by open circuit potential (OCP), electrochemical impedance spectroscopy and potentiodynamic polarisation. Investigation of surface morphology under SEM revealed dense lamellar coatings with porosity decreasing from 2.84% at 170 mm to 1.38% at 190 mm, indicating improved particle melting and coating compactness. The coating deposited at 190 mm exhibited the best electrochemical performance, with lowest corrosion rate (0.113 mmpy), compared with the uncoated substrate (2.60 mmpy). All coated specimens had a homogenous and compact coating structure. The results demonstrate that 190 mm is the optimum spray distance for producing high-integrity Cr₃C₂–NiCr coatings on DSS 2205, providing enhanced corrosion protection for components operating in aggressive acidic industrial environments. This work demonstrates that optimizing the D -gun spray distance significantly influences the microstructural integrity and electrochemical corrosion behaviour of Cr₃C₂–25NiCr coatings on DSS 2205. The established processing–microstructure–performance relationship provides a scientific basis for optimizing D -gun coating parameters to enhance corrosion resistance in aggressive acidic environments.

zh-Hans.title: D-gun喷涂Cr3C2–NiCr涂层在酸性环境下对DSS 2205的喷涂距离影响
zh-Hans.abstract: 金属陶瓷涂层是陶瓷硬度与金属性韧性的结合，主要用于提高金属的耐磨性和耐腐蚀性。爆炸喷涂（D-gun）是最具前景的热喷涂技术之一，可制备高质量的陶瓷涂层。由于Cr3C2–NiCr涂层具有优异的力学性能和耐腐蚀特性，因此具有较好的应用价值。采用1 M H2SO4在严苛酸性条件下评估了D-gun喷涂Cr3C2–NiCr涂层的性能；1 M H2SO4作为标准化实验室电解质，用于评估与工业酸性环境相关的耐腐蚀性，其中包括喷涂距离等关键工艺变量，而喷涂距离对于孔隙率、结合力、表面粗糙度和硬度等其他涂层性能的确定至关重要。采用Cr3C2–NiCr在三种喷涂距离下对双相不锈钢（DSS）2205进行喷涂，分别为170 mm、180 mm和190 mm，以研究Cr3C2–NiCr在酸性条件下的行为。通过开路电位（OCP）、电化学阻抗谱和动电位极化，在室温下对1 M H2SO4溶液中的涂层电化学活性进行了评估。SEM下的表面形貌研究表明，涂层为致密的层状结构，孔隙率随喷涂距离增加而降低，从170 mm时的2.84%降至190 mm时的1.38%，表明颗粒熔化更充分且涂层致密性更好。190 mm处沉积的涂层表现出最佳电化学性能，腐蚀速率最低（0.113 mmpy），而未涂覆基体的腐蚀速率为2.60 mmpy。所有涂覆试样均具有均匀且致密的涂层结构。结果表明，190 mm是获得DSS 2205上高完整性Cr3C2–NiCr涂层的最佳喷涂距离，可为在严苛酸性工业环境中运行的部件提供更强的耐腐蚀保护。本研究表明，优化D-gun喷涂距离会显著影响DSS 2205上Cr3C2–25NiCr涂层的微观结构完整性和电化学腐蚀行为。所建立的工艺—微观结构—性能关系为优化D-gun涂层参数、提高严苛酸性环境下的耐腐蚀性提供了科学依据。

infographic.key_insight: 190 mm的喷涂距离在1 M H2SO4中使Cr3C2–NiCr涂层在DSS 2205上形成最致密的涂层并获得最佳耐腐蚀性。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 优化D-gun喷涂距离可显著提升不锈钢部件在严苛工业服役中的涂层完整性和酸腐蚀防护能力。
method: 在170 mm、180 mm和190 mm距离下将D-gun喷涂的Cr3C2–NiCr沉积到DSS 2205上。
使用OCP、EIS和动电位极化评估1 M H2SO4中的腐蚀行为。
通过SEM比较不同喷涂距离下涂层形貌和孔隙率。
infographic.evidence_signal: 孔隙率从170 mm时的2.84%降至190 mm时的1.38%，且190 mm涂层的腐蚀速率最低（0.113 mmpy），相比之下未涂覆基体为2.60 mmpy。
infographic.watch_item: 结果仅适用于该涂层体系、酸浓度和室温测试条件，因此最佳距离可能会随不同工艺参数或服役环境而变化。

title: Explainable machine learning approach for predicting mechanical characteristics of AA6082–AA7075 friction stir welded joints
authors: K Giridharan, K Thavasilingam, D Srinivasan, RM Sakthi Sadhasivam, M Vinothkumar, D Manikandan
abstract: This study presents an effective Machine Learning (ML)-based framework for predicting the mechanical properties of Friction Stir Welded (FSW) joints using key welding parameters. Tool Rotational Speed (TRS), Traverse Speed (TTS), and Tool Plunge Depth (TPD) were considered as input variables, while Ultimate Tensile Strength (UTS) and micro-hardness were selected as output responses. Experimental data were used to develop and evaluate five regression models: Linear Regression (LR), Random Forest (RF), Support Vector Regression (SVR), Extreme Gradient Boosting (XGBoost), and K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN). Model performance was assessed using Mean Absolute Error (MAE), Root Mean Square Error (RMSE), Relative Absolute Error (RAE), and Root Relative Squared Error (RRSE) with an 80:20 training–testing split. Among the developed models, ensemble learning techniques demonstrated superior predictive capability for UTS. The Random Forest model achieved the best performance with the lowest testing MAE and RMSE values of 9.007 MPa and 12.975 MPa, respectively, while XGBoost also showed strong prediction accuracy. For micro-hardness prediction, SVR with a radial basis function kernel produced the highest accuracy, with MAE and RMSE values of 0.923 HV and 1.155 HV, respectively. Experimental validation confirmed that optimized welding conditions of 900 rpm rotational speed, 20 mm/min traverse speed, and 4.89 mm plunge depth significantly enhanced weld performance, resulting in a UTS of 281 MPa, micro-hardness of 138.4 HV, and refined nugget zone grain size of approximately 7 μm. The findings demonstrate that ML-driven approaches provide reliable prediction and optimization of FSW properties supporting intelligent manufacturing and potentially contributing to more efficient welding process design for sustainable applications.

infographic.key_insight: Machine learning can accurately predict and help optimize the tensile strength and micro-hardness of AA6082–AA7075 friction stir welded joints from a small set of welding parameters.
infographic.engineering_relevance: The study shows that data-driven models can guide parameter selection in friction stir welding to improve joint performance and reduce trial-and-error experimentation.
method: Inputs: tool rotational speed, traverse speed, and plunge depth.
Outputs: ultimate tensile strength and micro-hardness.
Compared five regressors: LR, RF, SVR, XGBoost, and KNN with an 80:20 train-test split.
infographic.evidence_signal: Random Forest gave the best UTS prediction on the test set (MAE 9.007 MPa, RMSE 12.975 MPa), while SVR with an RBF kernel was best for micro-hardness (MAE 0.923 HV, RMSE 1.155 HV).
infographic.watch_item: Performance is based on a limited experimental dataset, so generalization to other materials, tool geometries, or welding setups should be validated before deployment.
infographic.paper_title: Explainable machine learning approach for predicting mechanical characteristics of AA6082–AA7075 friction stir welded joints

zh-Hans.title: AA6082–AA7075搅拌摩擦焊接接头机械特性预测的可解释机器学习方法
zh-Hans.abstract: 本研究提出了一种有效的基于机器学习（ML）的框架，利用关键焊接参数预测搅拌摩擦焊（FSW）接头的力学性能。将工具转速（TRS）、焊接行进速度（TTS）和工具压入深度（TPD）作为输入变量，并选取极限抗拉强度（UTS）和显微硬度作为输出响应。基于实验数据建立并评估了五种回归模型：线性回归（LR）、随机森林（RF）、支持向量回归（SVR）、极端梯度提升（XGBoost）和K近邻（KNN）。采用80:20的训练–测试划分，并使用平均绝对误差（MAE）、均方根误差（RMSE）、相对绝对误差（RAE）和根相对平方误差（RRSE）评估模型性能。在所开发的模型中，集成学习技术在UTS预测方面表现出更优的预测能力。随机森林模型表现最佳，其测试集MAE和RMSE最低，分别为9.007 MPa和12.975 MPa，而XGBoost也表现出较强的预测精度。对于显微硬度预测，采用径向基函数核的SVR获得最高精度，其MAE和RMSE分别为0.923 HV和1.155 HV。实验验证表明，优化后的焊接条件为900 rpm转速、20 mm/min行进速度和4.89 mm压入深度，可显著提升焊接性能，使UTS达到281 MPa、显微硬度达到138.4 HV，并使焊核区晶粒尺寸细化至约7 μm。研究结果表明，机器学习驱动的方法能够可靠地预测和优化FSW性能，为智能制造提供支持，并有助于实现更高效的焊接工艺设计，从而服务于可持续应用。

infographic.key_insight: 机器学习可以基于少量焊接参数，准确预测并帮助优化AA6082–AA7075搅拌摩擦焊接接头的抗拉强度和显微硬度。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 该研究表明，数据驱动模型可指导搅拌摩擦焊中的参数选择，以提升接头性能并减少试错实验。
method: 输入：工具转速、行进速度和压入深度。
输出：极限抗拉强度和显微硬度。
比较了五种回归器：LR、RF、SVR、XGBoost和KNN，采用80:20训练-测试划分。
infographic.evidence_signal: 随机森林在测试集上的UTS预测表现最佳（MAE 9.007 MPa，RMSE 12.975 MPa），而采用RBF核的SVR在显微硬度预测方面最佳（MAE 0.923 HV，RMSE 1.155 HV）。
infographic.watch_item: 该性能基于有限的实验数据集，因此在部署前应验证其向其他材料、工具几何形状或焊接设置的泛化能力。

title: Thermal Sprayed Oxide Coatings for Stainless Steel Containers Used with Molten Al–Si and Al–Cu–Si Phase Change Materials: Compatibility and Thermal Cycling Stability
authors: Carolina Villada, Nuria Martínez Navarrete, Christian Semmler, Matthias Blum, Matthias Kolbe, Veronika Stahl
abstract: The application of aluminium-based metallic phase change materials (mPCMs) in latent heat thermal energy storage is limited by the poor compatibility of molten alloys with conventional stainless steel containers. This work evaluates thermally sprayed oxide coatings deposited directly on 304 stainless steel as protective barriers for molten Al–Si and Al–Cu–Si phase change materials. Alumina (Al2O3), zirconia (ZrO2) and Al2O3/ZrO2 (60/40 wt. %) coatings were produced by atmospheric plasma spraying (APS) and high-velocity suspension flame spraying (HVSFS) and assessed through coating characterisation, long-term static compatibility tests, thermal cycling experiments and thermal contact resistance measurements. APS coatings exhibited a pronounced dependence of coating thickness on spray angle, whereas the HVSFS coating provided a more uniform thickness distribution. After two weeks of static exposure, no reaction layer formation, coating dissolution or detectable elemental interdiffusion was observed for the investigated coating systems. For the Al2O3/Al–12.3 wt. % Si system, no coating degradation or interfacial reaction was detected after approximately 300 thermal cycles. Furthermore, average liquid thermal contact resistances of 0.31 × 10−3 and 0.39 × 10−3 m2 K W−1 were measured for smooth and rough Al–Si/coating interfaces, respectively. These results demonstrate that thermally sprayed oxide coatings can effectively protect stainless steel from molten aluminium-based PCMs while providing design-relevant data for the development of high-temperature latent heat thermal energy storage systems.

infographic.key_insight: Thermally sprayed oxide coatings on 304 stainless steel can act as stable barrier layers against molten Al-Si and Al-Cu-Si phase change materials without obvious degradation under long exposure or cycling.
infographic.engineering_relevance: These coatings improve container compatibility for high-temperature latent heat thermal energy storage, enabling safer and more durable stainless-steel hardware for aluminium-based mPCM systems.
method: APS and HVSFS oxide coatings were deposited directly on 304 stainless steel.
Coatings studied: Al2O3, ZrO2, and Al2O3/ZrO2 (60/40 wt. %).
Performance was checked by static compatibility, thermal cycling, and thermal contact resistance tests.
infographic.evidence_signal: After two weeks of static exposure and about 300 thermal cycles, the study reports no reaction layers, no coating dissolution, no detectable interdiffusion, and liquid thermal contact resistances of 0.31×10^-3 and 0.39×10^-3 m² K W^-1 for smooth and rough interfaces.
infographic.watch_item: Results are promising but are based on limited laboratory exposure durations and specific coating/process conditions, so long-term industrial durability and scale-up still need confirmation.
infographic.paper_title: Thermal Sprayed Oxide Coatings for Stainless Steel Containers Used with Molten Al–Si and Al–Cu–Si Phase Change Materials: Compatibility and Thermal Cycling Stability

zh-Hans.title: 用于与熔融 Al–Si 和 Al–Cu–Si 相变材料配合使用的不锈钢容器的热喷涂氧化物涂层：相容性与热循环稳定性
zh-Hans.abstract: 铝基金属相变材料（mPCM）在潜热热能存储中的应用受到熔融合金与传统不锈钢容器相容性差的限制。本工作评估了直接沉积在304不锈钢上的热喷涂氧化物涂层作为熔融 Al–Si 和 Al–Cu–Si 相变材料的保护屏障。采用大气等离子喷涂（APS）和高速悬浮液火焰喷涂（HVSFS）制备了氧化铝（Al2O3）、氧化锆（ZrO2）以及 Al2O3/ZrO2（60/40 wt. %）涂层，并通过涂层表征、长期静态相容性测试、热循环实验和热接触热阻测量进行评估。APS 涂层的厚度对喷涂角度表现出明显依赖性，而 HVSFS 涂层提供了更均匀的厚度分布。经过两周静态暴露后，在所研究的涂层体系中未观察到反应层形成、涂层溶解或可检测的元素互扩散。对于 Al2O3/Al–12.3 wt. % Si 体系，经过约300次热循环后未检测到涂层劣化或界面反应。此外，对于平滑和粗糙 Al–Si/涂层界面，测得的平均液体热接触热阻分别为 0.31 × 10−3 和 0.39 × 10−3 m2 K W−1。这些结果表明，热喷涂氧化物涂层能够有效保护不锈钢免受熔融铝基 mPCM 的侵蚀，同时为高温潜热热能存储系统的开发提供了具有设计参考价值的数据。

infographic.key_insight: 304 不锈钢上的热喷涂氧化物涂层可作为稳定的阻挡层，抵抗熔融 Al-Si 和 Al-Cu-Si 相变材料，在长时间暴露或循环条件下无明显劣化。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 这些涂层提高了高温潜热热能存储中的容器相容性，使铝基 mPCM 系统可采用更安全、更耐久的不锈钢硬件。
method: 将 APS 和 HVSFS 氧化物涂层直接沉积在 304 不锈钢上。
研究的涂层包括：Al2O3、ZrO2 和 Al2O3/ZrO2（60/40 wt. %）。
通过静态相容性、热循环和热接触热阻测试评估性能。
infographic.evidence_signal: 在两周静态暴露和约300次热循环后，研究报告未发现反应层、涂层溶解、可检测的互扩散，并且平滑和粗糙界面的液体热接触热阻分别为 0.31×10^-3 和 0.39×10^-3 m² K W^-1。
infographic.watch_item: 结果具有积极意义，但基于有限的实验室暴露时长和特定的涂层/工艺条件，因此长期工业耐久性和规模化应用仍需进一步验证。

title: Microstructure, Wear and Corrosion Resistances of Atmospheric Plasma, Detonation, High Velocity Oxy-fuel and High Velocity Air-fuel Sprayed WC-10Co-4Cr Cemented Carbide Coatings
authors: Ting XIA, Yueming WANG, Lu XIE
abstract: WC-10Co-4Cr cemented carbide coating has the advantages of superior wear property and corrosion resistance. WC-10Co-4Cr coatings were prepared on 304 stainless steel substrates by different thermal spray technologies including atmospheric plasma spraying (APS), detonation spraying (DS), high velocity oxy-fuel spraying (HVOFS), and high velocity air-fuel spraying (HVAFS), respectively. The microstructure, tribological properties and corrosion resistances of WC-10Co-4Cr coatings were systematically investigated and compared. The results showed that the Vickers hardness of cemented coatings prepared by APS, DS, HVOF, and HVAF, which were all higher than those of 304 stainless steel, were 771.4 HV, 954.2 HV, 1166.2 HV, and 1162.2 HV, respectively. The volume wear rate of 304 stainless steel was about (36.82±0.80)×10-5 mm3/N·m. The volume wear rates of APS, DS, HVOF, and HVAF coatings, which were all lower than that of 304 stainless steel, were about (7.93±0.30)×10-5, (1.51±0.20)×10-5, (1.17±0.10)×10-5, and (1.10±0.01)×10-5 mm3/N·m, respectively. In addition, the average friction coefficients of 304 stainless steel substrate, APS coating, DS one, HVOF one and HVAF one were about (0.68±0.03), (0.56±0.02), (0.48±0.01), (0.44±0.01) and (0.43±0.01), respectively. Spalling, microcracks perpendicular to the friction direction, and grooves parallel to the friction direction can be found in the wear marks of WC-10Co-4Cr coatings. Abrasive wear and fatigue wear are the main wear mechanisms of the cemented coatings. During the wear test, the carbide particles in DS, HVOF and HVAF coatings gradually became the main body bearing the friction load. Then the wear resistance of the latter three coatings was all superior to that of APS. Moreover, HVOF and HVAF coatings have better wear performances. For corrosion resistance from high to low were HVAF coating, DS one, HVOF one and APS one, respectively. The HVAF coating demonstrated the highest corrosion potential (-0.37±0.01 VSCE), smallest corrosion current density (1.75±0.02 μA/cm²), and largest corrosion resistance (20438.5 Ω) here. The APS coating had the poorest corrosion resistance among these four coatings.

infographic.key_insight: Thermal spray route strongly controls WC-10Co-4Cr coating density and phase retention, with HVOF/HVAF giving the best overall wear resistance while HVAF gives the best corrosion resistance.
infographic.engineering_relevance: For wear- and corrosion-critical components on 304 stainless steel, HVOF/HVAF and DS coatings can markedly outperform APS and the uncoated substrate.
method: Prepared WC-10Co-4Cr coatings on 304 stainless steel by APS, DS, HVOF, and HVAF.
Compared microstructure, Vickers hardness, friction/wear behavior, and electrochemical corrosion response.
Identified dominant wear mechanisms from worn-surface observations and load transfer to carbide particles.
infographic.evidence_signal: Compared with 304 stainless steel, coatings increased hardness to 771.4–1166.2 HV and reduced wear rate from 36.82×10^-5 to as low as 1.10×10^-5 mm3/N·m, while HVAF showed the best corrosion metrics (Ecorr ≈ -0.37 VSCE, Icorr ≈ 1.75 μA/cm²).
infographic.watch_item: Performance rankings are process- and parameter-dependent, so the reported superiority may not transfer directly to different spray settings, substrates, or service environments.
infographic.paper_title: Microstructure, Wear and Corrosion Resistances of Atmospheric Plasma, Detonation, High Velocity Oxy-fuel and High Velocity Air-fuel Sprayed WC-10Co-4Cr Cemented Carbide Coatings

zh-Hans.title: 大气等离子喷涂、爆炸喷涂、高速氧燃料喷涂和高速空气燃料喷涂WC-10Co-4Cr硬质合金涂层的显微组织、耐磨性与耐腐蚀性
zh-Hans.abstract: WC-10Co-4Cr硬质合金涂层具有优异的耐磨性能和耐腐蚀性能。采用不同热喷涂技术，包括大气等离子喷涂（APS）、爆炸喷涂（DS）、高速氧燃料喷涂（HVOFS）和高速空气燃料喷涂（HVAFS），分别在304不锈钢基体上制备WC-10Co-4Cr涂层。系统研究并比较了WC-10Co-4Cr涂层的显微组织、摩擦学性能和耐腐蚀性能。结果表明，采用APS、DS、HVOF和HVAF制备的硬质合金涂层的维氏硬度均高于304不锈钢，分别为771.4 HV、954.2 HV、1166.2 HV和1162.2 HV。304不锈钢的体积磨损率约为(36.82±0.80)×10-5 mm3/N·m。APS、DS、HVOF和HVAF涂层的体积磨损率均低于304不锈钢，分别约为(7.93±0.30)×10-5、(1.51±0.20)×10-5、(1.17±0.10)×10-5和(1.10±0.01)×10-5 mm3/N·m。此外，304不锈钢基体、APS涂层、DS涂层、HVOF涂层和HVAF涂层的平均摩擦系数分别约为(0.68±0.03)、(0.56±0.02)、(0.48±0.01)、(0.44±0.01)和(0.43±0.01)。在WC-10Co-4Cr涂层的磨痕中可见剥落、垂直于摩擦方向的微裂纹以及平行于摩擦方向的沟槽。磨粒磨损和疲劳磨损是这些硬质合金涂层的主要磨损机制。在磨损试验过程中，DS、HVOF和HVAF涂层中的碳化物颗粒逐渐成为承受摩擦载荷的主体。因此，后三种涂层的耐磨性均优于APS涂层。此外，HVOF和HVAF涂层表现出更好的耐磨性能。耐腐蚀性能由高到低依次为HVAF涂层、DS涂层、HVOF涂层和APS涂层。HVAF涂层在此表现出最高的腐蚀电位(-0.37±0.01 VSCE)、最小的腐蚀电流密度(1.75±0.02 μA/cm²)以及最大的耐腐蚀性(20438.5 Ω)。APS涂层在这四种涂层中耐腐蚀性最差。

infographic.key_insight: 热喷涂路线显著控制WC-10Co-4Cr涂层的致密性和相保留；其中HVOF/HVAF具有最佳综合耐磨性，而HVAF的耐腐蚀性最好。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 对于304不锈钢上对耐磨和耐腐蚀要求较高的部件，HVOF/HVAF和DS涂层可显著优于APS涂层及未涂覆基体。
method: 采用APS、DS、HVOF和HVAF在304不锈钢上制备WC-10Co-4Cr涂层。
比较显微组织、维氏硬度、摩擦/磨损行为以及电化学腐蚀响应。
通过磨损表面观察和向碳化物颗粒的载荷转移，识别主要磨损机制。
infographic.evidence_signal: 与304不锈钢相比，涂层将硬度提高至771.4–1166.2 HV，并将磨损率从36.82×10^-5降至最低1.10×10^-5 mm3/N·m；其中HVAF表现出最佳腐蚀指标（Ecorr ≈ -0.37 VSCE，Icorr ≈ 1.75 μA/cm²）。
infographic.watch_item: 性能排序受工艺和参数影响，因此文中所示优越性未必可直接迁移到不同的喷涂参数、基体或服役环境。

title: Microstructure and High-Temperature Oxidation Behaviour of HVOF and Plasma Sprayed Ni–Cr-Based Ceramic Coatings on SA516 Boiler Steel
authors: Ankur Gill, Vikas Chawla, Amit Handa, Santosh Kumar
abstract: This study investigates the microstructural and high-temperature oxidation behaviour of SA516 boiler steel coated with Ni-20Cr, Ni-20Cr+40TiC, and Ni-20Cr+40TiN using High Velocity Oxygen Fuel (HVOF) and Plasma Spray (PS) techniques. The cyclic air oxidation tests were performed for fifty cycles at 900°C in a simulated laboratory environment, and the resulting microstructural and phase changes were analyzed by means of X-ray Diffraction (XRD), Scanning Electron Microscopy with Energy Dispersive Spectroscopy (SEM/EDS), and X-ray mapping. The uncoated SA516 steel experienced intense spalling and cracking of the oxide layer, developing an unprotected phase (Fe 2 O 3 ). Among all coatings, the HVOF-sprayed Ni-20Cr+40TiC coating diminished maximum weight gain by 95.71 % compared to bare SA516 steel, indicating superior oxidation resistance. This enhanced performance of coatings is attributed to formation a dense, protective oxide layer consisting of Cr 2 O 3 , TiO 2 , NiTiO 4 , and NiO, coupled with reduced porosity and enhanced microhardness.

infographic.key_insight: HVOF Ni-20Cr+40TiC coating provided the best oxidation protection for SA516 boiler steel, cutting maximum weight gain by 95.71% versus uncoated steel after 50 cycles at 900°C.
infographic.engineering_relevance: The result shows that dense NiCr-based ceramic composite coatings can substantially improve high-temperature durability of boiler steels in cyclic oxidizing environments.
method: Compared Ni-20Cr, Ni-20Cr+40TiC, and Ni-20Cr+40TiN coatings deposited by HVOF and plasma spray.
Performed 50-cycle air oxidation tests at 900°C.
Characterized phases and microstructure using XRD, SEM/EDS, and X-ray mapping.
infographic.evidence_signal: The abstract reports severe spalling and Fe2O3 formation on bare steel, while the HVOF Ni-20Cr+40TiC coating showed the largest reduction in mass gain and formed protective Cr2O3, TiO2, NiTiO4, and NiO scales.
infographic.watch_item: Performance was evaluated under laboratory cyclic oxidation only, so long-term service behavior under real boiler conditions, thermal shock, and erosion still needs validation.

zh-Hans.title: SA516锅炉钢上HVOF和等离子喷涂Ni–Cr基陶瓷涂层的显微组织及高温氧化行为
zh-Hans.abstract: 本研究采用高速氧燃料喷涂（HVOF）和等离子喷涂（PS）技术，研究了涂覆Ni-20Cr、Ni-20Cr+40TiC和Ni-20Cr+40TiN的SA516锅炉钢的显微组织及高温氧化行为。在900°C模拟实验室环境中进行了50个循环的空气氧化试验，并通过X射线衍射（XRD）、配有能量色散光谱（SEM/EDS）的扫描电子显微镜以及X射线面分布分析对所得显微组织和相变进行了表征。未涂层SA516钢的氧化层发生了严重剥落和开裂，形成了未受保护的相（Fe 2 O 3）。在所有涂层中，HVOF喷涂的Ni-20Cr+40TiC涂层相较于裸SA516钢使最大增重降低了95.71%，表明其具有更优异的抗氧化性能。涂层性能的提升归因于形成了致密的保护性氧化层，其中包括Cr 2 O 3、TiO 2、NiTiO 4和NiO，同时孔隙率降低且显微硬度提高。

infographic.key_insight: HVOF Ni-20Cr+40TiC涂层为SA516锅炉钢提供了最佳抗氧化保护，在900°C下经过50个循环后，相较未涂层钢将最大增重降低了95.71%。

在900°C下进行了50个循环的空气氧化试验。
采用XRD、SEM/EDS和X射线面分布分析对相组成和显微组织进行了表征。
infographic.evidence_signal: 摘要报告称，裸钢出现严重剥落并形成Fe2O3，而HVOF Ni-20Cr+40TiC涂层表现出最大的增重降低，并形成了具有保护作用的Cr2O3、TiO2、NiTiO4和NiO氧化膜。

title: Molten pool dynamic behavior and arc characteristics in laser-TIG hybrid welding of Invar steel
authors: Sen WU, Fei ZHAO, Shuili GONG, Lifeng MA, Haiyan ZHAO, Wei ZHANG
abstract: Invar steel has an extremely low coefficient of thermal expansion, making it widely used in the manufacturing of molds for aerospace composite materials. Most existing studies focus on process aspects, lacking in-depth analysis of the fluid dynamics behavior of the molten pool. Therefore, numerical simulation and high-speed photography were employed to analyze the effects of different process parameters on the molten pool morphology evolution and arc characteristics during laser-TIG hybrid welding of Invar steel, which provides crucial theoretical support for the optimization of the Invar steel welding process. The results indicate that within the laser power range of 5 ~ 6 kW, the increased power leads to greater recoil pressure, which promotes a larger penetration depth and keyhole dimension, intensifies the overall molten pool flow, and makes the arc prone to being attracted by the laser and deflected at a high power. Within the welding speed range of 0.5 ~ 0.8 m/min, a higher speed reduces the heat input, leading to a decreased penetration depth and weld width, and an increased flow velocity and cooling rate of the molten pool; additionally, the arc is prone to deformation at a high speed. Within the welding current range of 150 ~ 170 A, the increased current enhances the arc force, promoting the expansion of weld width and intensifying the molten pool convection; furthermore, the arc is more stable at a high current.

infographic.key_insight: In laser-TIG hybrid welding of Invar steel, higher laser power and current intensify molten-pool convection and widen/ deepen the weld, while higher travel speed reduces heat input and shrinks penetration and weld width.
infographic.engineering_relevance: These parameter trends help tune hybrid welding settings for stable arc behavior and controlled weld geometry in low-thermal-expansion Invar components.
method: Numerical simulation of molten-pool flow and morphology evolution
High-speed photography of arc and pool behavior
Parametric study across laser power, welding speed, and current
infographic.evidence_signal: The abstract reports consistent parametric evidence across 5–6 kW laser power, 0.5–0.8 m/min welding speed, and 150–170 A current, linking each range to measurable changes in penetration, weld width, flow intensity, and arc stability.
infographic.watch_item: The findings are parameter-window specific, so transfer to different joint geometries, thicknesses, or shielding conditions should be validated experimentally.
infographic.paper_title: Molten pool dynamic behavior and arc characteristics in laser-TIG hybrid welding of Invar steel

zh-Hans.title: Invar钢激光-TIG复合焊接中的熔池动态行为与电弧特性
zh-Hans.abstract: Invar钢具有极低的热膨胀系数，因此广泛应用于航空航天复合材料模具制造。现有研究大多聚焦于工艺方面，缺乏对熔池流体动力学行为的深入分析。因此，本文采用数值模拟和高速摄影分析了不同工艺参数对Invar钢激光-TIG复合焊接过程中熔池形貌演化和电弧特性的影响，为Invar钢焊接工艺优化提供了重要的理论支持。结果表明，在5 ~ 6 kW的激光功率范围内，功率增加会导致反冲压力增大，从而促进更大的熔深和匙孔尺寸，增强整体熔池流动，并使电弧在高功率下更易受激光吸引并发生偏转。在0.5 ~ 0.8 m/min的焊接速度范围内，更高的速度会降低热输入，导致熔深和焊缝宽度减小，同时熔池流速和冷却速率增加；此外，在高速度下电弧更易发生变形。在150 ~ 170 A的焊接电流范围内，电流增加会增强电弧力，促进焊缝宽度扩展并强化熔池对流；此外，在高电流下电弧更加稳定。

infographic.key_insight: 在Invar钢激光-TIG复合焊接中，更高的激光功率和电流会增强熔池对流并加深/加宽焊缝，而更高的行进速度会降低热输入并减小熔深和焊缝宽度。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 这些参数变化趋势有助于调节复合焊接参数，以实现低热膨胀Invar构件中稳定的电弧行为和可控的焊缝几何形貌。

title: Rupture and growth of holes in the melt pool during laser keyhole welding of thin sheets
authors: Love O. John, Alexander F.H. Kaplan
abstract: Abstract This study investigates the formation and growth of holes during laser keyhole welding of 100 μm thin 316 L stainless-steel sheets in overlap joints, represented by bead-on-plate welding of 200 μm thick foils. Using high-speed imaging, keyhole instabilities, promoted by increasing line energy, were identified as precursors to hole nucleation. Continuous weld seams were obtained up to approximately 7 kJ/m, while hole formation occurred beyond this regime and cutting became dominant above approximately 12 kJ/m. The hole growth mechanism is described by the competition between vertical and horizontal surface-tension components associated with the local melt pool curvature. Once nucleated, holes expanded at approximately 0.8–1.2 m/s over 1–3 ms and developed into elliptical shapes before forming permanent perforations or cuts. A geometric stability criterion based on the Young-Laplace force balance indicates that unstable growth occurs when the hole length becomes comparable to the sheet thickness. The thinner the foil, the stronger the vertical force component promoting hole growth, reaching 17 kN/m² here. A systematic flow chart linking the observed sequence of keyhole instability, hole nucleation, and hole growth provides a basis for identifying precursor signatures and suppressing hole formation during thin-sheet laser welding.
venue: The International Journal of Advanced Manufacturing Technology

infographic.key_insight: In thin 316L foil laser welding, keyhole instability can trigger hole nucleation and rapid hole growth, with stability lost when the hole length approaches the sheet thickness.
infographic.engineering_relevance: The results define line-energy thresholds and a force-balance criterion that can help welders avoid perforation and cut-through in ultra-thin sheet lap joints.
method: High-speed imaging of laser keyhole welding on 100 μm 316L sheets (modeled with 200 μm foils)
Mapped the sequence from keyhole instability to hole nucleation and growth versus line energy
Used a Young-Laplace-based geometric stability balance to explain hole expansion

zh-Hans.title: 薄板激光小孔焊接过程中熔池内孔洞的破裂与生长
zh-Hans.abstract: 摘要 本研究考察了100 μm薄316L不锈钢板搭接接头在激光小孔焊接过程中孔洞的形成与生长，以200 μm厚箔材的单道焊作为代表。利用高速成像，发现由线能量增加所促进的小孔失稳是孔洞成核的前兆。在约7 kJ/m以内可获得连续焊缝，而超过该范围后会出现孔洞形成，并且在约12 kJ/m以上切割成为主导。孔洞生长机制可由与局部熔池曲率相关的垂直与水平表面张力分量之间的竞争来描述。一旦成核，孔洞在1–3 ms内以约0.8–1.2 m/s的速度扩展，并在形成永久性穿孔或切割之前发展为椭圆形。基于Young-Laplace力平衡的几何稳定性判据表明，当孔洞长度与板厚相当时，会发生不稳定生长。箔材越薄，促进孔洞生长的垂直力分量越强，此处可达17 kN/m²。将所观察到的小孔失稳、孔洞成核和孔洞生长的顺序系统化的流程图，为识别前兆特征以及在薄板激光焊接中抑制孔洞形成提供了依据。

infographic.key_insight: 在薄316L箔材的激光焊接中，小孔失稳可触发孔洞成核和快速孔洞生长，当孔洞长度接近板厚时稳定性丧失。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 这些结果界定了线能量阈值和力平衡判据，可帮助焊工避免超薄板搭接接头中的穿孔和切穿。
method: 对100 μm 316L板进行激光小孔焊接的高速成像（以200 μm箔材建模）
绘制随线能量变化的小孔失稳、孔洞成核与生长的演化序列

infographic.evidence_signal: 摘要报告连续焊缝可达约7 kJ/m，超过该范围后出现孔洞形成，约12 kJ/m以上切割占主导，且孔洞以约0.8–1.2 m/s的速度在1–3 ms内生长。

title: INVESTIGATION OF THE FORMATION OF STRUCTURE AND WEAR-RESISTANT PROPERTIES OF WC–CO–CR COATINGS PRODUCED BY HVOF AND DETONATION SPRAYING
authors: Arystanbek Kussainov, G.Zh. Zhunissova, Ermakhan Molbossynov, Нуртолеу Магазов, Rashid Kuanyshbay
abstract: The article presents a comparative analysis of WC–Co–Cr cermet coatings deposited by detonation spray (DS) and High Velocity Oxy-Fuel (HVOF) methods. The study included an analysis of the morphology of the initial powders, as well as the microstructure and phase composition of the coatings using Scanning Electron Microscopy (SEM) and Energy Dispersive Spectroscopy (EDS). The results show that the use of homogeneous, fully alloyed WC–Co–Cr powder ensures the formation of a dense, layered structure with a uniform distribution of the carbide phase within the metallic matrix. Detonation spraying produces a harder coating (average microhardness 1449 HV), whereas HVOF provides a coating with high density, uniform microstructure, and low friction coefficient (Kt = 0.143). The comparative analysis confirmed that the mechanical and tribological properties of the coatings strongly depend on the powder morphology and the spraying method. These findings allow for the determination of optimal processing conditions for WC–Co–Cr coatings, enhancing wear resistance and durability of machine parts, which is particularly relevant for operation under intensive friction and high load conditions.

infographic.key_insight: Homogeneous WC–Co–Cr powder enables dense cermet coatings, while spray method mainly tunes the balance between hardness and tribological performance.
infographic.engineering_relevance: For wear-critical machine parts, choosing between DS and HVOF lets engineers optimize either maximum hardness or lower friction and higher coating density.

Characterize powder morphology, coating microstructure, and phase composition using SEM and EDS.
Evaluate mechanical and tribological performance via microhardness and friction behavior.

zh-Hans.title: 采用 HVOF 和爆炸喷涂制备的 WC–Co–Cr 涂层结构形成与耐磨性能研究
zh-Hans.abstract: 本文对采用爆炸喷涂（DS）和高速火焰喷涂（HVOF）方法沉积的 WC–Co–Cr 金属陶瓷涂层进行了比较分析。研究包括采用扫描电子显微镜（SEM）和能量色散光谱（EDS）对初始粉末形貌以及涂层显微组织和相组成的分析。结果表明，使用均匀、完全合金化的 WC–Co–Cr 粉末可确保形成致密的层状结构，且碳化物相在金属基体中分布均匀。爆炸喷涂制备的涂层硬度更高（平均显微硬度 1449 HV），而 HVOF 制备的涂层具有较高致密度、均匀的显微组织以及较低的摩擦系数（Kt = 0.143）。比较分析证实，涂层的力学性能和摩擦学性能在很大程度上取决于粉末形貌和喷涂方法。这些发现有助于确定 WC–Co–Cr 涂层的最佳工艺条件，从而提高机械零件的耐磨性和耐久性，这对于在强摩擦和高载荷条件下工作的场合尤为重要。

infographic.engineering_relevance: 对于耐磨关键机械零件，选择 DS 或 HVOF 可使工程师优化获得最大硬度，或更低摩擦与更高涂层致密度。

infographic.evidence_signal: 摘要报告显示，DS 涂层更硬，平均显微硬度为 1449 HV，而 HVOF 制备的涂层致密、均匀，且摩擦系数较低（Kt = 0.143）。

title: Development of a Method for Producing Self-Fluxing Nickel-Based Coatings by Detonation Spraying
authors: Dastan Buitkenov, Laila Sulyubayeva, Daryn Baizhan, Nurmakhanbet Raisov, Nurkhat Bimakhan
abstract: This study investigated the influence of detonation spraying parameters on the structure and tribological and mechanical properties of self-fluxing coatings of the Ni–Cr–Fe–B–Si–C system. The investigated parameters included the barrel filling level (48–68%), the molar ratio of the working gases (O/C = 1.026–1.856), and the inter-shot delay (0–1 s). Morphological analysis of the coatings revealed a characteristic lamellar structure and a dependence of coating thickness and defect formation on the spraying conditions. A lower barrel filling level resulted in a denser coating structure with minimal porosity, whereas medium and high filling levels promoted the formation of microcracks, presumably due to increased residual stresses. Tribological tests showed that the minimum coefficient of friction was obtained at a barrel filling level of 48% (μ = 0.674 ± 0.136) and an O/C ratio of 1.026, but these conditions were also associated with increased wear. The highest wear resistance was obtained at an O/C ratio of 1.856 and an increased inter-shot delay of up to 1 s, resulting in a decrease in the specific wear rate to 0.000189 mm³/(N·m). Roughness analysis showed that increasing the inter-shot delay reduced Ra from 5.00 to 3.60 μm, which may be attributed to a reduction in thermal load and more favorable coating formation conditions. The maximum hardness, up to 905.6 HV, was obtained for a combination of parameters that promoted the formation of a dense structure and strengthening phases. The results indicate that optimizing the detonation spraying parameters requires a trade-off between reducing the coefficient of friction and increasing wear resistance. The findings can be used to develop tech nologies for the restoration and surface strengthening of machine components.
venue: Bulletin of the Karaganda University Physics Series

infographic.engineering_relevance: Optimizing barrel filling, gas ratio, and inter-shot delay can improve coating performance for restoration and surface strengthening of machine components.

infographic.watch_item: Lower friction conditions increased wear, so the process must be tuned carefully to avoid sacrificing durability for low drag.

zh-Hans.title: 爆炸喷涂制备自熔性镍基涂层方法的开发
zh-Hans.abstract: 本研究考察了爆炸喷涂参数对 Ni–Cr–Fe–B–Si–C 系统自熔性涂层组织以及摩擦学和力学性能的影响。所研究的参数包括炮管填充率（48–68%）、工作气体摩尔比（O/C = 1.026–1.856）以及两次发射间隔（0–1 s）。涂层的形貌分析表明，其具有典型的层片状结构，并且涂层厚度和缺陷形成依赖于喷涂条件。较低的炮管填充率导致涂层结构更致密、孔隙率更低，而中等和较高的填充率促进了微裂纹的形成，这可能是由于残余应力增加所致。摩擦学测试表明，在炮管填充率为 48%（μ = 0.674 ± 0.136）且 O/C 比为 1.026 时获得了最低摩擦系数，但这些条件也伴随着较高的磨损。当 O/C 比为 1.856 且两次发射间隔增至 1 s 时，获得了最高的耐磨性，使比磨损率降低至 0.000189 mm³/(N·m)。粗糙度分析表明，增大两次发射间隔可使 Ra 从 5.00 降至 3.60 μm，这可能归因于热负荷降低以及更有利的涂层形成条件。最高硬度可达 905.6 HV，出现在促进致密结构和强化相形成的一组参数组合下。结果表明，爆炸喷涂参数的优化需要在降低摩擦系数和提高耐磨性之间进行权衡。这些发现可用于开发机器零部件修复和表面强化技术。

infographic.key_insight: 爆炸喷涂参数强烈控制自熔性 Ni–Cr–Fe–B–Si–C 涂层中涂层致密性、摩擦、耐磨性和硬度之间的权衡。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 优化炮管填充率、气体比和两次发射间隔可提高用于机器零部件修复和表面强化的涂层性能。
method: 将炮管填充率在 48–68% 范围内变化。
调整工作气体摩尔比（O/C = 1.026–1.856）。
将两次发射间隔从 0 调整至 1 s，并评估涂层显微组织、粗糙度、硬度、摩擦和磨损。
infographic.evidence_signal: 最佳摩擦性能出现在 48% 填充率且 O/C = 1.026 时（μ = 0.674 ± 0.136），而最佳耐磨性出现在 O/C = 1.856 且间隔为 1 s 时，比磨损率降至 0.000189 mm³/(N·m)。
infographic.watch_item: 较低摩擦条件会增加磨损，因此必须谨慎调控工艺，避免为了降低阻力而牺牲耐久性。

title: THE EFFECT OF THE COMPOSITION OF METAL-CERAMIC POWDERS ON THE STRUCTURE AND PERFORMANCE PROPERTIES OF COATINGS OBTAINED BY THE HVOF METHOD
authors: Yermakhan Molbosynov, Arystanbek Kussainov, Нуртолеу Магазов, Indira Abizhanova, Rashid Kuanyshbay, Abai Alimov
abstract: The article presents the results of a comprehensive study of WC–Co–Cr, WC–NiCr, WC–Ni, Cr₃C₂–NiCr, and Al₂O₃–NiCr cermet coatings deposited onto a 65G steel substrate by the high-velocity oxy-fuel (HVOF) spraying method. An analysis of the microstructure (SEM/EDS), microhardness, surface roughness, tribological characteristics, and adhesive strength of the coatings was carried out. It was established that the composition of the powder mixture and the characteristics of the binder phase significantly affect the formation of the structure and performance properties of the coatings. The WC–Co–Cr coating formed the densest and most structurally homogeneous lamellar structure, demonstrating the lowest coefficient of friction (μ = 0.143), the highest microhardness (1316.87 HV), and high resistance to scratch loading. The Cr₃C₂–NiCr and WC–NiCr coatings showed satisfactory tribological characteristics (μ = 0.310 and 0.326, respectively); however, reduced adhesive strength was observed for the Cr₃C₂–NiCr coating. The WC–Ni coating was characterized by an increased coefficient of friction (0.545) at moderate hardness values (721.2 HV). The highest coefficient of friction was found for the Al₂O₃–NiCr coating (0.630), while this system also demonstrated the lowest microhardness (631.59 HV) and instability in structure formation. The surface roughness of the coatings was in the range of Ra = 3.881–8.130 μm and depended on the spraying conditions. The obtained results made it possible to determine that the WC–Co–Cr coating provides the optimal combination of mechanical and tribological properties and is the most promising for application under conditions of intensive abrasive-adhesive wear in mechanical engineering, power engineering, and metallurgy.

infographic.key_insight: Among HVOF-sprayed cermet coatings on 65G steel, WC–Co–Cr delivered the best overall structure–property balance, combining the densest microstructure, highest hardness, and lowest friction.
infographic.engineering_relevance: For wear-critical machine, power, and metallurgy components, powder/binder selection in HVOF directly controls coating densification, adhesion, hardness, and tribological performance.
method: Compared five HVOF coating systems: WC–Co–Cr, WC–NiCr, WC–Ni, Cr3C2–NiCr, and Al2O3–NiCr.
Evaluated microstructure by SEM/EDS plus microhardness, surface roughness, friction/wear behavior, and adhesive strength.
Related performance differences to powder composition and binder-phase characteristics.
infographic.evidence_signal: The abstract reports quantitative property data showing WC–Co–Cr at μ = 0.143 and 1316.87 HV, while Al2O3–NiCr had the highest friction (0.630) and lowest hardness (631.59 HV).
infographic.watch_item: Results are based on a specific HVOF setup and 65G steel substrate, so coating ranking and adhesion may shift with spray parameters, substrate prep, or service environment.
infographic.paper_title: THE EFFECT OF THE COMPOSITION OF METAL-CERAMIC POWDERS ON THE STRUCTURE AND PERFORMANCE PROPERTIES OF COATINGS OBTAINED BY THE HVOF METHOD

zh-Hans.title: HVOF法制备金属-陶瓷粉末组成对涂层结构与性能的影响
zh-Hans.abstract: 本文对通过高速氧燃料（HVOF）喷涂方法沉积在65G钢基体上的WC–Co–Cr、WC–NiCr、WC–Ni、Cr₃C₂–NiCr和Al₂O₃–NiCr金属陶瓷涂层进行了综合研究。对涂层的显微组织（SEM/EDS）、显微硬度、表面粗糙度、摩擦学特性和黏附强度进行了分析。结果表明，粉末混合物的组成及粘结相的特征会显著影响涂层结构和使用性能的形成。WC–Co–Cr涂层形成了最致密且结构最均匀的层状组织，表现出最低的摩擦系数（μ = 0.143）、最高的显微硬度（1316.87 HV）以及较高的抗划伤载荷能力。Cr₃C₂–NiCr和WC–NiCr涂层表现出令人满意的摩擦学特性（分别为μ = 0.310和0.326）；然而，Cr₃C₂–NiCr涂层观察到较低的黏附强度。WC–Ni涂层在中等硬度值（721.2 HV）下表现出较高的摩擦系数（0.545）。Al₂O₃–NiCr涂层的摩擦系数最高（0.630），同时该体系还表现出最低的显微硬度（631.59 HV）和结构形成不稳定性。涂层表面粗糙度范围为Ra = 3.881–8.130 μm，并受喷涂条件影响。所得结果表明，WC–Co–Cr涂层兼具最优的力学和摩擦学性能组合，是机械工程、电力工程和冶金领域中在强烈磨粒-黏着磨损条件下最具应用前景的涂层。

infographic.key_insight: 在65G钢上采用HVOF喷涂的金属陶瓷涂层中，WC–Co–Cr在结构—性能平衡方面表现最佳，兼具最致密的显微组织、最高的硬度和最低的摩擦系数。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 对于对耐磨性要求极高的机械、电力和冶金部件，HVOF中的粉末/粘结相选择可直接控制涂层致密化、黏附性、硬度和摩擦学性能。
method: 比较了五种HVOF涂层体系：WC–Co–Cr、WC–NiCr、WC–Ni、Cr3C2–NiCr和Al2O3–NiCr。
通过SEM/EDS以及显微硬度、表面粗糙度、摩擦/磨损行为和黏附强度评估显微组织。
将性能差异与粉末组成和粘结相特征联系起来。
infographic.evidence_signal: 摘要给出的定量性能数据表明，WC–Co–Cr的μ = 0.143、硬度为1316.87 HV，而Al2O3–NiCr具有最高摩擦系数（0.630）和最低硬度（631.59 HV）。
infographic.watch_item: 结果基于特定的HVOF工艺参数和65G钢基体，因此涂层排序和黏附性可能会随喷涂参数、基体预处理或服役环境而变化。

title: A Comparative Analysis of Multitask Neural Networks and Stacking Ensemble Learning for Predicting UTS, Weld Hardness, and HAZ Hardness in Welding Applications
authors: Sama Mukhtar, Amit Sata, Gaurang Joshi, Durgesh Srivastava
abstract: Accurately predicting welding performance measures like ultimate strength (UTS), weld bead hardness, and HAZ mechanical hardness is crucial for ensuring the structural integrity and performance of welded components. Multitask learning (MTL) refers to a machine learning approach in which one model is designed to handle several interconnected tasks at the same time. Instead of training separate models for each task, MTL shares representations among tasks, allowing them to leverage common patterns while maintaining task-specific distinctions. In this study, we compared two advanced machine learning techniques, namely multitask neural network (MTNN) and stacking ensemble learning, for predicting these parameters based on a shared dataset. A multitask neural network (MTNN) is a specific type of multitask learning (MTL) model that uses a deep neural network architecture to handle multiple related tasks simultaneously. In MTNN, different tasks share some hidden layers while having task-specific output layers. This shared representation allows the model to learn common patterns across tasks while maintaining task-specific outputs. Both methods are evaluated using RMSE and R<sup>2</sup> to determine their predictive accuracy and overall effectiveness. It showed robust prediction strength, as its RMSE outcomes are 0.1288 for UTS, 0.0886 for weld hardness, and 0.1125 for HAZ hardness, whereas R<sup>2</sup> values are 0.6724, 0.9215, and 0.8407, respectively. This underlines that it can generalize well in interrelated tasks. Stacking ensemble learning outperformed MTL in the accuracy of individual tasks: the RMSE for UTS is 0.0263 and R<sup>2</sup> is 0.9863; for weld hardness, it is 0.0467 and 0.9782; and for HAZ hardness, it is 0.1109 and 0.8453. Such results indicate the good ability of ensemble methods to produce highly accurate, task-specific predictions. This comparison reveals the trade-offs between the two approaches. MTL is good in scenarios where the tasks are related and the data are sparse, giving efficient training and good generalization; stacking ensembles work better in the case of accurate, independent predictions. In both cases, they show remarkable potential for improving the predictive power of welding applications, making them suitable precursors to further investigation into hybrid models that bring the best features of both approaches together.

infographic.key_insight: Stacking ensemble learning delivered the most accurate predictions for UTS, weld hardness, and HAZ hardness, while multitask neural networks provided strong shared-task generalization.
infographic.engineering_relevance: For welding process optimization, the study shows that predictive models can support faster quality assessment of joint strength and hardness without relying solely on exhaustive testing.
method: Compared multitask neural networks (shared hidden layers, task-specific outputs) with stacking ensemble learning.
Used a shared dataset to predict three welding properties: UTS, weld hardness, and HAZ hardness.
Evaluated both approaches using RMSE and R² across all tasks.
infographic.evidence_signal: MTNN achieved RMSE/R² of 0.1288/0.6724 for UTS, 0.0886/0.9215 for weld hardness, and 0.1125/0.8407 for HAZ hardness, while stacking improved to 0.0263/0.9863, 0.0467/0.9782, and 0.1109/0.8453 respectively.
infographic.watch_item: Performance may depend on dataset size and task coupling; stacking can outperform on accuracy but may be less efficient and less transferable than shared multitask models.
infographic.paper_title: A Comparative Analysis of Multitask Neural Networks and Stacking Ensemble Learning for Predicting UTS, Weld Hardness, and HAZ Hardness in Welding Applications

zh-Hans.title: 用于焊接应用中预测 UTS、焊缝硬度和 HAZ 硬度的多任务神经网络与堆叠集成学习的比较分析
zh-Hans.abstract: 准确预测焊接性能指标，如极限强度（UTS）、焊缝硬度和 HAZ 力学硬度，对于确保焊接构件的结构完整性和性能至关重要。多任务学习（MTL）是一种机器学习方法，其中一个模型被设计用于同时处理若干相互关联的任务。与其为每个任务分别训练独立模型，MTL 不同任务之间共享表示，使其能够利用共同模式，同时保持任务特定差异。本研究基于共享数据集，对两种先进机器学习技术，即多任务神经网络（MTNN）和堆叠集成学习，进行了比较，以预测这些参数。多任务神经网络（MTNN）是多任务学习（MTL）的一种特定类型模型，它使用深度神经网络架构同时处理多个相关任务。在 MTNN 中，不同任务共享部分隐藏层，同时具有任务特定的输出层。这种共享表示使模型能够学习跨任务的共同模式，同时保持任务特定输出。两种方法均使用 RMSE 和 R² 进行评估，以确定其预测准确性和总体有效性。结果表明，其具有较强的预测能力，RMSE 分别为 UTS 的 0.1288、焊缝硬度的 0.0886 和 HAZ 硬度的 0.1125，而 R² 值分别为 0.6724、0.9215 和 0.8407。这表明它能够在相互关联的任务中实现良好的泛化。堆叠集成学习在单个任务的准确性方面优于 MTL：UTS 的 RMSE 为 0.0263、R² 为 0.9863；焊缝硬度的 RMSE 为 0.0467、R² 为 0.9782；HAZ 硬度的 RMSE 为 0.1109、R² 为 0.8453。此类结果表明，集成方法具有产生高度准确、任务特定预测的良好能力。该比较揭示了两种方法之间的权衡。MTL 适用于任务相关且数据稀疏的场景，能够提供高效训练和良好泛化；堆叠集成在需要高精度、独立预测的情况下表现更好。两种方法都显示出提升焊接应用预测能力的显著潜力，因此适合作为进一步研究混合模型的前驱，以结合两种方法的最佳特性。

infographic.key_insight: 堆叠集成学习为 UTS、焊缝硬度和 HAZ 硬度提供了最准确的预测，而多任务神经网络则在共享任务泛化方面表现出较强能力。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 对于焊接工艺优化，该研究表明预测模型可在不完全依赖穷尽性试验的情况下，支持更快速地评估接头强度和硬度质量。
method: 将多任务神经网络（共享隐藏层、任务特定输出）与堆叠集成学习进行比较。
使用共享数据集预测三项焊接性质：UTS、焊缝硬度和 HAZ 硬度。
使用 RMSE 和 R² 对两种方法在所有任务上的表现进行评估。
infographic.watch_item: 性能可能取决于数据集规模和任务耦合程度；堆叠方法在准确性方面可能更优，但其效率和可迁移性可能低于共享式多任务模型。

title: Biomaterials and biomechanical design of distal weight-bearing implants: Computational modeling, biomaterial interfaces, and clinical translation
authors: Muntadher Saleh Mahdi, Ayad M. Takhakh, Mohamed Hamdy Doweidar
abstract: Distal Weight-Bearing Implants (DWBIs) represent a clinically emerging class of load-bearing medical devices in which biomaterial design, surface architecture, and biomechanical performance are tightly coupled. Their success depends not only on restoring distal support in transfemoral rehabilitation, but also on the ability of metallic, ceramic, and composite biomaterial interfaces to sustain cyclic loading while promoting durable bone-implant integration. However, distal support also changes bending moments, shear stresses, micromotion, coating durability, and biological demands at the bone-implant interface. This systematic review synthesizes DWBI concepts, geometry optimization, finite element analysis with gait-phase loading, Functionally Graded Materials (FGMs), graded Ti-HAp (hydroxyapatite) architectures, in-vivo osseointegration evidence, and clinical translation pathways. A quantitative trend analysis was performed on 34 direct-contribution papers and 32 empirical studies to assess trends, validation depth, and translation readiness. However, more than half of the empirical evidence remained at the bench or simulation level, while animal and human/clinical studies formed a smaller validation layer. HAp-centered surface or bulk material engineering represented a substantial share of the corpus; however, evidence for graded Ti-HAp/FGM architectures was derived predominantly from non-DWBI biomaterial and mechanistic analog studies, supporting mechanistic plausibility rather than DWBI-specific validation. Mechanistically, DWBI should be interpreted as an integrated biomaterial-mechanical system linking macro-geometry, metallic/ceramic surface architecture, graded Ti-HAp interfaces, gait-phase loading, tribology/corrosion behavior, in-vivo fixation, and clinical workflow. Translation will require patient-realistic loading conditions, validated finite element analysis workflows, device-level fatigue and coating-integrity testing, standardized in-vivo endpoints, harmonized rehabilitation protocols, and registry-supported clinical follow-up linking mechanical plausibility to durable biological fixation and patient-level benefit.

infographic.key_insight: Distal weight-bearing implants work best when biomechanical design, graded biomaterial interfaces, and coating durability are co-optimized to preserve load transfer while promoting long-term bone integration.
infographic.engineering_relevance: The paper shows that clinically viable transfemoral implants need gait-phase validated finite element models, fatigue-resistant Ti-HAp/FGM interfaces, and coating systems that can survive cyclic bending, shear, and micromotion.
method: Systematic review of DWBI geometry, biomaterials, and clinical translation literature
Trend analysis of 34 direct-contribution papers and 32 empirical studies
Synthesis of finite element analysis, graded Ti-HAp/FGM, and in-vivo osseointegration evidence
infographic.evidence_signal: The evidence base is still early-stage: more than half of the empirical studies were bench or simulation level, with fewer animal and human/clinical validations.
infographic.watch_item: A major implementation risk is overreliance on mechanistic analogs, since graded Ti-HAp/FGM evidence is largely not DWBI-specific and needs device-level fatigue and coating-integrity validation.
infographic.paper_title: Biomaterials and biomechanical design of distal weight-bearing implants: Computational modeling, biomaterial interfaces, and clinical translation

zh-Hans.title: 远端承重植入物的生物材料与生物力学设计：计算建模、生物材料界面与临床转化
zh-Hans.abstract: 远端承重植入物（DWBIs）代表一类临床上正在兴起的承重医疗器械，其生物材料设计、表面构型与生物力学性能高度耦合。其成功不仅取决于在股骨假肢康复中恢复远端支撑，还取决于金属、陶瓷和复合生物材料界面在促进持久骨-植入物整合的同时承受循环载荷的能力。然而，远端支撑也会改变弯矩、剪应力、微动、涂层耐久性以及骨-植入物界面的生物学需求。本系统综述综合了DWBI概念、几何优化、采用步态阶段载荷的有限元分析、功能梯度材料（FGMs）、梯度Ti-HAp（羟基磷灰石）结构、体内骨整合证据以及临床转化路径。我们对34篇直接贡献论文和32项实证研究进行了定量趋势分析，以评估发展趋势、验证深度和转化就绪度。然而，超过一半的实证证据仍停留在台架或仿真层面，而动物和人体/临床研究构成了较小的验证层。以HAp为中心的表面或块体材料工程占据了相当大的文献比例；然而，关于梯度Ti-HAp/FGM结构的证据主要来自非DWBI生物材料及机理类比研究，支持的是机理上的可行性，而非DWBI特异性的验证。从机理上看，DWBI应被视为一个集成的生物材料-力学系统，连接宏观几何、金属/陶瓷表面构型、梯度Ti-HAp界面、步态阶段载荷、摩擦学/腐蚀行为、体内固定以及临床流程。实现转化将需要患者真实世界的载荷条件、经验证的有限元分析流程、器械级疲劳和涂层完整性测试、标准化体内终点、协调统一的康复方案，以及由注册数据库支持的临床随访，以将力学上的可行性与持久的生物学固定和患者层面的获益联系起来。

infographic.key_insight: 当生物力学设计、梯度生物材料界面和涂层耐久性协同优化时，远端承重植入物在保持载荷传递的同时也能促进长期骨整合，从而表现最佳。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 该文表明，临床可行的股骨假体植入物需要经过步态阶段验证的有限元模型、耐疲劳的Ti-HAp/FGM界面，以及能够承受循环弯曲、剪切和微动的涂层系统。
method: 对DWBI几何、生物材料与临床转化文献进行系统综述
对34篇直接贡献论文和32项实证研究进行趋势分析
综合有限元分析、梯度Ti-HAp/FGM以及体内骨整合证据
infographic.evidence_signal: 证据基础仍处于早期阶段：超过一半的实证研究处于台架或仿真层面，动物和人体/临床验证相对较少。
infographic.watch_item: 一个主要实施风险是过度依赖机理类比，因为梯度Ti-HAp/FGM证据大多并非DWBI特异性，且需要器械级疲劳和涂层完整性验证。

title: Long-term corrosion behaviors and wear behavior of Fe-based amorphous coatings in different humidity environments
authors: Shuai Cui, Haimin Zhai, Zihan Feng, Xuqiang Li, Wensheng Li, Xiangjuan Fan
abstract: Fe-based amorphous coatings (Fe-based AMCs) were successfully prepared on Q235 carbon steel by detonation spray under different spraying parameters. The corrosion and tribology behaviors of coatings were systematically tested. The droplets show disk-like morphology with the highest circularity and expansion factor, which is crucial to reduce the defects of coatings and to form fine-lamellar-structures coatings with dense microstructure. A higher incidence of porosity defects in the coating is associated with reduced long-term corrosion resistance. Moreover, the tribo-chemical reactions between Si3N4 balls and water molecules play a significant role in wear behaviors for coating in different humidity conditions. The friction coefficient and wear rate of coatings decrease as the humidity conditions increase.

infographic.key_insight: Detonation-sprayed Fe-based amorphous coatings achieve better long-term corrosion and wear performance when droplets spread into dense, disk-like splats that minimize porosity.
infographic.engineering_relevance: Process parameters in detonation spraying can be tuned to improve coating density, corrosion durability, and humidity-dependent tribological performance on carbon steel components.
method: Fe-based amorphous coatings were deposited on Q235 carbon steel by detonation spray under different spraying parameters.
Corrosion behavior was evaluated over long-term exposure, and wear behavior was tested under different humidity environments using Si3N4 counterbodies.
Droplet morphology, circularity, expansion factor, and coating porosity were analyzed as microstructure indicators.
infographic.evidence_signal: The abstract reports systematic corrosion and tribology testing, with results showing lower porosity linked to improved corrosion resistance and decreasing friction coefficient and wear rate as humidity increases.
infographic.watch_item: Coating performance is sensitive to spraying-induced porosity and to environmental humidity, so process control and service-condition matching are critical.
infographic.paper_title: Long-term corrosion behaviors and wear behavior of Fe-based amorphous coatings in different humidity environments

zh-Hans.title: 不同湿度环境下Fe基非晶涂层的长期腐蚀行为与磨损行为
zh-Hans.abstract: 采用爆炸喷涂在不同喷涂参数下于Q235碳钢表面成功制备了Fe基非晶涂层（Fe-based AMCs）。系统测试了涂层的腐蚀和摩擦学行为。液滴呈盘状形貌，具有最高的圆形度和铺展因子，这对于减少涂层缺陷并形成致密微细层状结构涂层至关重要。涂层中较高的孔隙缺陷发生率与较低的长期耐腐蚀性相关。此外，在不同湿度条件下，Si3N4球与水分子之间的摩擦化学反应对涂层的磨损行为起着重要作用。随着湿度条件的增加，涂层的摩擦系数和磨损率降低。

infographic.key_insight: 爆炸喷涂Fe基非晶涂层在液滴铺展形成致密、盘状飞溅并最大限度减少孔隙时，可获得更优的长期耐腐蚀和耐磨性能。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 可通过调控爆炸喷涂工艺参数来提高碳钢部件涂层的致密性、耐腐蚀持久性以及随湿度变化的摩擦学性能。
method: 采用不同喷涂参数，通过爆炸喷涂在Q235碳钢上沉积Fe基非晶涂层。
评估长期暴露条件下的腐蚀行为，并使用Si3N4对偶体在不同湿度环境下测试磨损行为。
分析液滴形貌、圆形度、铺展因子和涂层孔隙率作为微观结构指标。
infographic.evidence_signal: 摘要报道了系统的腐蚀与摩擦学测试，结果表明较低孔隙率与更好的耐腐蚀性相关，且随着湿度增加，摩擦系数和磨损率降低。
infographic.watch_item: 涂层性能对喷涂引起的孔隙率以及环境湿度都很敏感，因此工艺控制与服役条件匹配至关重要。

title: EFFECT OF FLAME-SPRAYING TEMPERATURE ON THE PROPERTIES OF Ni–Cr–B–Si-BASED SELF-FLUXING COATINGS
authors: Dastan Buitkenov, Manarbek Kylyshkanov, Daryn Baizhan, Nurmakhanbet Raisov, Nurkhat Bimakhan
abstract: The present study investigates the effect of flame-spraying process parameters on the microstructure and mechanical properties of Ni–Cr–B–Si-based self-fluxing coatings. Corrosion-resistant AISI 321 austenitic chromium–nickel steel was used as the substrate material. The coatings were deposited by flame spraying using a Metal Coat 6PM-II system. To vary the thermal conditions of the spraying process, the oxygen-to-acetylene (O₂/C₂H₂) ratio was adjusted to 1.0, 1.1, and 1.2. The spraying parameters were monitored using an Accuraspray 4.0 diagnostic system. The resulting coatings were characterized in terms of microstructure, porosity, microhardness, surface roughness, and adhesion strength. Increasing the O₂/C₂H₂ ratio resulted in densification of the coating structure and a decrease in porosity from 1.97 ± 0.13% to 0.90 ± 0.09%. Concurrently, the surface roughness decreased from 4.70 ± 0.09 μm to 2.99 ± 0.11 μm, while the adhesion strength increased from 22.14 ± 4.3 MPa to 35.02 ± 3.9 MPa. The highest average microhardness of 1051.7 HV was obtained at an O₂/C₂H₂ ratio of 1.1. Among the investigated spraying conditions, the coating produced at O₂/C₂H₂ = 1.2 exhibited the lowest porosity and surface roughness together with the highest adhesion strength. The results demonstrate that controlling the O₂/C₂H₂ ratio provides an effective means of tailoring the microstructural and mechanical characteristics of flame-sprayed Ni–Cr–B–Si-based self-fluxing coatings.
venue: Journal of Surface Engineering and Coating Technology

infographic.key_insight: Tuning the flame-spraying O2/C2H2 ratio strongly changes Ni–Cr–B–Si coating quality, with higher ratios generally producing denser, smoother, and better-adhered coatings.
infographic.engineering_relevance: This gives a practical process-control lever for optimizing self-fluxing spray coatings on corrosion-resistant steel in wear- and corrosion-critical applications.
method: Flame-sprayed Ni–Cr–B–Si self-fluxing coatings onto AISI 321 stainless steel using a Metal Coat 6PM-II system.
Varied the oxygen-to-acetylene ratio at 1.0, 1.1, and 1.2 to adjust thermal conditions.
Used Accuraspray 4.0 and post-test characterization to measure microstructure, porosity, microhardness, roughness, and adhesion.
infographic.evidence_signal: The abstract reports porosity dropping from 1.97 ± 0.13% to 0.90 ± 0.09%, roughness from 4.70 ± 0.09 μm to 2.99 ± 0.11 μm, and adhesion rising from 22.14 ± 4.3 MPa to 35.02 ± 3.9 MPa across the tested ratios, with peak microhardness of 1051.7 HV at O2/C2H2 = 1.1.
infographic.watch_item: The optimal ratio depends on which property is prioritized, since the highest microhardness occurred at 1.1 while the best density, smoothness, and adhesion were obtained at 1.2.
infographic.paper_title: EFFECT OF FLAME-SPRAYING TEMPERATURE ON THE PROPERTIES OF Ni–Cr–B–Si-BASED SELF-FLUXING COATINGS

zh-Hans.title: 火焰喷涂温度对Ni–Cr–B–Si基自熔性涂层性能的影响
zh-Hans.abstract: 本研究考察了火焰喷涂工艺参数对Ni–Cr–B–Si基自熔性涂层显微组织和力学性能的影响。采用耐腐蚀的AISI 321奥氏体铬镍钢作为基体材料。涂层通过使用Metal Coat 6PM-II系统进行火焰喷涂制备。为改变喷涂过程的热条件，将氧-乙炔（O₂/C₂H₂）比调节为1.0、1.1和1.2。喷涂参数采用Accuraspray 4.0诊断系统进行监测。对所得涂层的显微组织、孔隙率、显微硬度、表面粗糙度和结合强度进行了表征。提高O₂/C₂H₂比导致涂层结构致密化，孔隙率从1.97 ± 0.13%降至0.90 ± 0.09%。同时，表面粗糙度从4.70 ± 0.09 μm降至2.99 ± 0.11 μm，而结合强度从22.14 ± 4.3 MPa提高到35.02 ± 3.9 MPa。在O₂/C₂H₂比为1.1时获得了最高平均显微硬度1051.7 HV。在所研究的喷涂条件中，O₂/C₂H₂ = 1.2时制备的涂层表现出最低的孔隙率和表面粗糙度，同时具有最高的结合强度。结果表明，通过控制O₂/C₂H₂比，可有效调控火焰喷涂Ni–Cr–B–Si基自熔性涂层的显微组织和力学特性。

infographic.key_insight: 调节火焰喷涂中的O2/C2H2比会显著改变Ni–Cr–B–Si涂层质量；总体上，更高的比值通常会获得更致密、更平滑且结合更好的涂层。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 这为在耐腐蚀钢上优化自熔性喷涂涂层提供了一个实用的工艺控制手段，适用于耐磨和耐腐蚀关键应用。
method: 使用Metal Coat 6PM-II系统将Ni–Cr–B–Si自熔性涂层火焰喷涂到AISI 321不锈钢上。
将氧-乙炔比设为1.0、1.1和1.2，以调节热条件。
使用Accuraspray 4.0及后续测试表征测量显微组织、孔隙率、显微硬度、粗糙度和结合强度。
infographic.evidence_signal: 摘要报告，在所测试的比值范围内，孔隙率从1.97 ± 0.13%降至0.90 ± 0.09%，粗糙度从4.70 ± 0.09 μm降至2.99 ± 0.11 μm，结合强度从22.14 ± 4.3 MPa升至35.02 ± 3.9 MPa；在O2/C2H2 = 1.1时获得峰值显微硬度1051.7 HV。
infographic.watch_item: 最佳比值取决于优先关注的性能，因为最高显微硬度出现在1.1，而最佳致密性、平滑性和结合强度出现在1.2。

title: Enhancing weld performance of AA2024-T351 using drilled-to-bossed geometry and deep learning prediction in direct drive friction welding
authors: Eyob Messele Sefene, Alemayehu Admas Abay, Akshansh Mishra, Assefa Asmare Tsegaw, William Gomez, Addisalem Desalegn Sisay
abstract: Abstract The growing demand for lightweight, high-strength materials in the aerospace and automotive industries has brought aluminium alloys such as AA2024-T351 into the spotlight due to their outstanding strength-to-weight ratio. However, achieving reliable joints in such alloys remains a significant challenge, particularly when using conventional welding techniques. To address this, the present study focuses on optimizing process parameters in Direct Drive Friction Welding (DDFW) for AA2024-T351. A novel drilled-to-bossed geometry, inspired by the traditional mortise-and-tenon joint, is introduced to enhance mechanical interlocking and improve weld integrity. Experimental trials were systematically designed using an L18 orthogonal array to evaluate both tensile and torsional strength. The experiments were conducted on a customized engine lathe, with friction pressure, forging pressure, spindle speed, faying surface geometry, and friction time selected as the controllable process parameters. In parallel, advanced deep learning models, including an ensemble residual network, a compact attention network, and an adaptive multiscale network, were implemented to predict ultimate tensile strength based on the welding conditions. The results revealed that the optimal parameter combination of 30 MPa friction pressure, 70 MPa forging pressure, 2200 rpm spindle speed, drilled-to-bossed geometry, and 4 min of friction time yielded exceptional mechanical performance, achieving a tensile strength of 538 MPa and torsional strength of 325 MPa. The drilled-to-bossed configuration demonstrated significantly higher joint strength compared to conventional flat-to-flat joints. Moreover, among the deep learning models, the ensemble residual network achieved the highest predictive accuracy with an R² value of approximately 0.81, effectively capturing the complex relationship between process parameters and weld strength.

infographic.key_insight: A drilled-to-bossed joint geometry combined with optimized DDFW parameters substantially improves AA2024-T351 weld strength, while deep learning can predict tensile performance from process settings.
infographic.engineering_relevance: The study offers a practical joint-design and process-optimization pathway for stronger lightweight aluminum connections in aerospace and automotive manufacturing.
method: Used an L18 orthogonal array to test friction pressure, forging pressure, spindle speed, faying-surface geometry, and friction time.
Compared conventional flat-to-flat and drilled-to-bossed geometries in direct drive friction welding on a customized engine lathe.
Trained deep learning models to predict ultimate tensile strength from welding conditions.
infographic.evidence_signal: The best setup (30 MPa friction pressure, 70 MPa forging pressure, 2200 rpm, drilled-to-bossed geometry, 4 min friction time) achieved 538 MPa tensile strength and 325 MPa torsional strength; the ensemble residual network reached R² ≈ 0.81.
infographic.watch_item: The predictive model performance is moderate rather than definitive, so broader datasets and validation on additional joint geometries and alloys would be needed before deployment.
infographic.paper_title: Enhancing weld performance of AA2024-T351 using drilled-to-bossed geometry and deep learning prediction in direct drive friction welding

zh-Hans.title: 通过钻孔-凸台几何形貌和直接驱动摩擦焊中的深度学习预测提升 AA2024-T351 的焊接性能
zh-Hans.abstract: 摘要 航空航天和汽车工业对轻质、高强度材料的需求不断增长，使 AA2024-T351 等铝合金因其优异的比强度而备受关注。然而，在此类合金中实现可靠接头仍是一项重大挑战，尤其是在采用传统焊接技术时。为此，本研究聚焦于优化 AA2024-T351 的直接驱动摩擦焊（DDFW）工艺参数。受传统榫卯接头启发，提出一种新型钻孔-凸台几何形貌，以增强机械互锁并提高焊接完整性。采用 L18 正交表对实验进行系统设计，以评估拉伸强度和扭转强度。实验在定制发动机车床上进行，选择摩擦压力、镦粗压力、主轴转速、接合面几何形貌和摩擦时间作为可控工艺参数。同时，实施了先进的深度学习模型，包括集成残差网络、紧凑注意力网络和自适应多尺度网络，用于基于焊接条件预测极限抗拉强度。结果表明，30 MPa 摩擦压力、70 MPa 镦粗压力、2200 rpm 主轴转速、钻孔-凸台几何形貌以及 4 min 摩擦时间的最佳参数组合具有优异的力学性能，获得了 538 MPa 的抗拉强度和 325 MPa 的扭转强度。与传统平对平接头相比，钻孔-凸台构型表现出显著更高的接头强度。此外，在深度学习模型中，集成残差网络取得了最高预测精度，R² 值约为 0.81，能够有效捕捉工艺参数与焊缝强度之间的复杂关系。

infographic.key_insight: 钻孔-凸台接头几何形貌与优化后的 DDFW 参数相结合，可显著提升 AA2024-T351 焊接强度，同时深度学习能够根据工艺设置预测拉伸性能。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 该研究为航空航天和汽车制造中更高强度的轻质铝连接提供了一条实用的接头设计与工艺优化路径。
method: 采用 L18 正交表测试摩擦压力、镦粗压力、主轴转速、接合面几何形貌和摩擦时间。
在定制发动机车床上的直接驱动摩擦焊中比较了传统平对平几何形貌与钻孔-凸台几何形貌。
训练深度学习模型以根据焊接条件预测极限抗拉强度。
infographic.evidence_signal: 最佳参数组合（30 MPa 摩擦压力、70 MPa 镦粗压力、2200 rpm、钻孔-凸台几何形貌、4 min 摩擦时间）获得了 538 MPa 的抗拉强度和 325 MPa 的扭转强度；集成残差网络达到 R² ≈ 0.81。
infographic.watch_item: 该预测模型性能属于中等而非决定性，因此在部署前还需要更大规模的数据集，以及在更多接头几何形貌和合金上的验证。
